body:
Web ListPage gained a "Clear checked (N)" button (red, small, next to the
show-checked toggle) that bulk-moves every checked item to backlog — an
explicit user request implementing the spec's "clearing done items -> backlog"
transition (design doc §3 lifecycle table). Android has no equivalent: the only
route from checked to backlog is opening each item's edit dialog and changing
the status dropdown, one by one. After every shopping trip this is the natural
"finish up" action, so the gap bites on the primary client.

Fix: same semantics as web — button/action visible when checked items exist
(count shown), sets status=backlog on all checked items of the list in one
repo call (one dirty batch -> one sync push). Placement suggestion: alongside
the Show-checked switch row in ListScreen, or overflow menu; keep destructive
color + maybe snackbar undo (restore previous statuses) since it's a bulk
change. Files: ui/list/ListScreen.kt + ListViewModel.kt, ItemsRepo (bulk
setStatus), tests.
title: Android: missing 'Clear checked' bulk action (web has it; user-requested feature)
